items.effect: kept: shown from the value saved in the file; the saved value and the formula are kept and written back, and the formula's cell references follow row and column insert and delete (they do not follow anything else, and the value does not update when the cells it refers to change, so it may be out of date; Excel recalculates the formula when the file is reopened, possibly to a different result)
items.label: formula(s) the editor cannot calculate (kept as saved)

items.effect: approximated: spills like Excel's and is saved back as a dynamic array (with the range it spilled and Excel's dynamic-array metadata), so Excel shows it as a dynamic array
items.label: dynamic-array formula(s)

items.effect: kept: shown from the value saved in the file, not calculated
items.label: formula(s) using functions the editor does not have

items.effect: approximated: recalculated on import; the file's saved value is not kept
items.label: formula(s) using volatile functions (NOW, RAND, OFFSET...)
